title: THE INJECTORS SOUND LIKE INJECTORS
why: His order of 2026-10-12: add sounds for bandaging, applying armour and the rest. A Stim Injector and the self-revive played the menu chirp. Now a stim clicks its cap and hisses in, and the self-revive hisses its injector and rattles your gear as you get up, before the revive sting it already had. The sounds are the recorded CC0 foley from the v25.20 bank. Yours is centred on your side of the speakers and your teammates hear it where you stand. Sound only: nothing in the game changes.
now: A stim now clicks and hisses in, and the self-revive hisses its injector and rattles your gear as you get up.

edits.replacement: G.tel.revives++; if(!injFoley('revive')) blip('pick'); try{ sndRevLand(); }catch(_rl){}   // v16.xx (usefoleyd): the injector and the gear
